This is an express whole-order revocation naming EO 12291 by number, with no carve-out; secs. 9-10 are only agency-authority and judicial-review disclaimers. The other machine-found actors (EO 12319, 12371, 12482, 12492, 12495, 12621, 12637) are amendments or exemptions, not endings. No later held instrument revives EO 12291. Independent view NO; I agree.
